Catalog

Drag a primitive onto the page. Drawings become images, elements keep their style, backgrounds apply to the page.

Write it in Markdown; it flows onto the page. A manuscript is plain text, kept with the project as a .md file, laid out as you type. Each block shows on the page as a manuscript block; convert any of them into a component of your own to move, restyle or animate it.

or drop CSS, Markdown, folders or a .zip anywhere. Fonts and images they point to are baked in.

        About PIXIWYG


        Everything you make stays on this computer. PIXIWYG sends nothing anywhere.

        Report a problem

        Describe what happened under “What happened”, then save the report and attach it to your beta feedback. Nothing is sent from here.

        Open in another window

        “” is open in another window. Two windows saving the same project would overwrite each other.

        Taking over makes the other window read-only and opens the latest saved version here.

        Primitives

        Import Markdown

        Each block becomes its own element: headings, paragraphs, lists, quotes, code, tables, rules and images. Bold, italic, links and inline code carry over. To bring images along, drop the .md together with them as a folder or .zip.

        Text effects

        Select words or letters below, pick an effect, Apply. Effects stay in the page with no script; moving ones rest for visitors who ask for less motion.

        In this element

        Filters

        Brush
        The preview is live. Scribble on it to try the brush; every change redraws your scribbles too.
        Tip

        The tip is a shape wearing the style, like any element on the page, filled with the foreground color.

          No model yet

          A low-poly model (.obj with its .mtl and textures, .glb, .gltf or .stl) becomes one image holding every angle. The page shows one angle, spins through them, or lets visitors drag it round. Up to 20,000 triangles.

          Load style set

          Like loading a brush set: choose stylesheets and see what each brings before anything changes. Append adds them to what you have; Replace turns the current sheets off (they stay in the project, ready to turn back on).

          References

          Point at files and folders the site needs without putting them in the project: a video, a downloads folder, a dataset. Only the path is kept, relative to the published page. The saved file carries a REFERENCES.md saying where each one goes.

          Autoformat

          Arranges every element in reading order, top to bottom and left to right, with even spacing. Text blocks take the column width. The painting stays where it is.
